summary: POSCO Holdings Inc. filed a Form 6-K furnishing provisional Q2 2026 earnings results for its subsidiary POSCO, prepared on a separate basis under K-IFRS. The filing discloses revenue of 9.42 trillion KRW for Q2 2026, operating profit of 0.27 trillion, and net profit of 0.06 trillion, with year-over-year declines. The review by independent auditors is not finalized, so figures may change. This is a routine earnings disclosure by a foreign private issuer, not a special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, or restructuring. No transaction terms or strategic actions are mentioned.
